response.sql: WITH transaction_averages AS (SELECT s.transref AS transaction_reference, t.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s INNER JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist), mix_averages AS (SELECT order_type_mix, AVG(avg_short_interest) AS mix_avg_short_interest FROM transaction_averages GROUP BY order_type_mix) SELECT ta.transaction_reference, ta.order_type_mix, ta.avg_short_interest, ta.avg_option_volume_ratio, ta.avg_short_interest / NULLIF(ma.mix_avg_short_interest, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM transaction_averages AS ta INNER JOIN mix_averages AS ma ON ta.order_type_mix IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ma.order_type_mix ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
